features.quote: max_turns: hard ceiling on tool-loop iterations
features.justification_quote: More turns → more failure exposure → higher reproduction, higher cost

features.quote: terminate on: max_turns reached | model emits explicit DONE/GIVE-UP sentinel | hard token budget exceeded | repeated identical action guard
permission_to_quit (control): system prompt explicitly says "if you determine the task cannot be completed, say so and stop
finish(summary) — model's explicit "I'm done / giving up" signal
Early-stop on confident degradation: optional. If cheap deterministic signals cross a high bar before max_turns... we can stop early
features.justification_quote: the spiral is already demonstrated, extra turns just cost money
